title: eriophyllum confertiflorum var. tanacetifolium
intro: Eriophyllum confertiflorum var. tanacetifolium, commonly known as Tanacetum-leaved Woolly Sunflower, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is native to California and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Eriophyllum confertiflorum var. tanacetifolium include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
